description.value: Atlin Mountain Inn is a fully renovated 20-room hotel on Lake Street in the remote northern BC community of Atlin, featuring the famous Atlin lake view from guest rooms. The property includes a fine dining restaurant and the old-fashioned Discovery Saloon, making it a genuine hub in a small, isolated town. Amenities are notably broad for the region, including a guest kitchen, laundry machines, free continental breakfast, and new EV charging on-site.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website at atlininn.com is fully accessible and provides rich detail. Phone, address, and email all match OSM exactly. Bike storage and staff bike procedures are not mentioned anywhere on the site, so both required criteria are null. Laundry machines, vending machine, Wi-Fi, and on-site evening food (Discovery Saloon and restaurant) are all explicitly confirmed on the Rooms and Info pages; EV vehicle charging is mentioned but is car-level infrastructure with no specific reference to e-bike compatibility.
concerns: Page title includes 'Hotels Near Whitehorse Airport, Hotels Near Nelson' — appears to be SEO metadata only, not indicative of a location mismatch.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, open, year-round hotel in a remote northern BC community — clearly valuable to touring cyclists passing through Atlin.

Nearby evening food.detail: On-site fine dining restaurant and Discovery Saloon; website also notes other restaurants in town are open

Vending machines.detail: Vending machine in the lobby with fresh meals and snacks to go

wow_evidence: genuine hub in a small, isolated town... guest kitchen, laundry machines, free continental breakfast, and new EV charging on-site
